name: Omaset - Omarchy Settings
author: b2amedina
description: Settings shouldn’t be a treasure hunt through dotfiles. Omaset lets you manage every Omarchy setting in one place — a window for your hands, a CLI for your scripts, an MCP server for your agent. It doesn’t just toggle values; it manages how things work together: routing sites to browsers and more. One engine, three faces. That's the Omarchy way, made visible.
